name: BRIJ Flight API
description: Flight API for paid flight search, escrow-backed booking intents, booking execution, refund requests, and Duffel order status lookup.
use_when: Use when the user wants to search flights, create a booking intent, book a flight, request a refund, or check flight order status.
how_to_call: Read openapi_url, build the target URL from x402.http_base_url plus the OpenAPI path, then call BRIJ MCP tool brij_pay.
